ov: A medium-sized wild cat of Asian forests, named for the large cloud-like blotches on its grey or ochre coat. One of the best climbers among cats, it can climb down tree trunks head first, using its long tail for balance.
rg: From the Himalayan foothills in Nepal, Bhutan and India through mainland Southeast Asia to southern China.
df: Tree-dwelling and ground animals such as macaques, hog deer, porcupines, pangolins and squirrels.
fx: Called a "modern-day sabre-tooth", it has upper canines 4 cm or longer.
It rests in trees by day and hunts on the forest floor at night.
